note: Cutscene scripts. Times are story seconds; `pace` maps story time to real seconds ([story start, story end, playback rate], rate < 1 slows the scene so captions can be read; null end = open). The game reads the intro from here (src/data/introScript.js) and the bible's Videos tab renders every entry. Scene ids match camera shots in introScript.js. Keep public/data/videos.json in sync for the deployed bible.

scenes.title: The Winding World
scenes.description: Fade in from black. Slow descending fly-in over the archipelago at night: torus islands, a wedge-of-two-circles island, orb islands on rock spires, all linked by glowing teal causeways over a luminous sea. Gyroid is a small figure on the Retract Reef walkway in the foreground.

scenes.title: The ringed island
scenes.description: Close, slow orbit around the central ringed island, intact, its eight amber beacons lit. Causeways arc away from it to the other islands.

scenes.title: Gyroid on the reef
scenes.description: Gyroid stands idle on the thick teal walkway with its amber spine, facing along the path. The camera eases in from a three-quarter front angle. Gyroid's theme plays.

scenes.title: Establishing orbit
scenes.description: Wide orbit high over the whole world, settling toward the ringed island at its center. Black spire visible in the distance.

scenes.title: Count Null revealed
scenes.description: On top of his black spire, the camera rises from Null's robe hem up to his porcelain mask while the Null Crown floats down onto its place above his hood (7–9.6). At 9.6 the crown begins to glow and he half-raises his open hand; fragments orbit above his palm.

scenes.title: The thrust
scenes.description: Over Null's shoulder: he thrusts his hand toward the ring (13.6–14.4). A violet beam fires from the crown to the ringed island (14.0).

scenes.title: The collapse
scenes.description: Wide on the ring. It turns violet and flickers (from 14.2); its hole closes as it swells into a ball (14.6–19), shrinks to a point (19.1–20) and vanishes in a white-violet flash (19.9) with camera shake. The four causeways tied to the ring snap loose and fall into the sea (19.6–22.5).

scenes.title: The run
scenes.description: Tracking shot alongside Gyroid sprinting down the walkway (21–27.6). Behind them, the teal slabs shudder, turn violet and fall away one by one, but the amber spine stays in place.

scenes.title: The edge
scenes.description: Gyroid stops at the end of the walkway and turns toward camera, looking back at the ruined path where only the spine remains.

scenes.title: Anchor set
scenes.description: Gyroid casts the anchor spool: a luminous loop opens around them (30.9–32.2) and drops onto the spine (32.4–33.4), which flares bright. Camera pulls back and up.

scenes.title: Null watches
scenes.description: Back on the spire: Null, calm, watches from afar and gives a small dismissive gesture (36.5–39).

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Wide pull-back over the reef with the ring now missing from the center. Title card fades in at 40.5: “Winding World — Shape can change. Topology can’t.” and “World 0 · Level 1 — A Good Deformation”. Fade to black at 46, then Level 1 starts.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Beyond the edge of every map lies the Winding World: islands shaped like rings and loops, strung together by glowing causeways.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Here the land is soft. It stretches, bends and drifts with the tides — and nothing is lost, so long as nothing tears.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: What the land truly guards are its holes. Stretch a ring as far as you like and it stays a ring — and every route around it holds.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Gyroid, a courier born of the surfaces themselves, runs messages along those routes, an anchor spool always at the hip.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: One delivery for Emmy Boundary, out on Retract Reef. Easy run today.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: But high on a spire of black glass, someone had been counting those holes — and he meant to be rid of every one.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: So many loops. So many… holes.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Enough. I will simplify every province — down to a single perfect point.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: But the Null Crown does not simplify. It erases.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: A ring becomes a ball. A ball becomes a point. Every route that wound through it — gone.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Gyroid! The reef is going — stay on the amber spines! Whatever keeps its shape, we can save!

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: The walkways fell… but the spines held. Bend it, don’t break it.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: A courier who keeps holes. How… quaint. Run along, little loop.

videos.title: Into Bouquet Bastion
videos.plays: After castle-0 (The Hollow Throne), before World 1 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: Null escaped the Hollow Throne still insisting a ring is just a point — and World 0 had no tool to prove him wrong. Gyroid and Emmy follow him into Bouquet Bastion, where two loop districts meet at a single beacon and the Commutator's ribbon patrols keep travel order. Plant the need for an invariant: loops you can and cannot shrink (π₁). Null's new claim: the sphere is as simple as a point, because every loop on it shrinks.

videos.title: Into Chain Delta
videos.plays: After castle-1 (The Commutator's Keep), before World 2 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: The Commutator's patrol is broken, but Null retreats to the sphere, where loops are blind. Gyroid descends into Chain Delta, wetlands of oriented triangles where shared edges cancel and a missing center survives. Set up homology: boundaries, cycles, holes of every dimension. Null's new claim: the torus and S¹ ∨ S¹ ∨ S² are the same place, because their homology matches.

videos.title: Into the Cup Product Gardens
videos.plays: After castle-2 (The Retractor), before World 3 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: Null's ball-to-boundary retractor failed (H₂(B³) = 0 — Brouwer one dimension up). The Commutator shows up in disguise at a counterfeit station that matches the torus group for group. Gyroid enters the signal gardens, where cochains read chains backwards and classes multiply. Null's new claim: every map S³ → S² is trivial.

videos.title: Up the Postnikov Spire
videos.plays: After castle-3 (The Counterfeit Station), before World 4 · Level 1
videos.synopsis: Unmasked by a nonzero cup product, the Commutator's station falls and Null retreats up his tower into higher homotopy. The ascent: rooms that unfold into higher dimensions, the Null Crown waiting at the top. Null's final claim: give him the homotopy groups and he can rebuild any space — the twists don't matter.

videos.title: The Crown Unwound
videos.plays: After castle-4 (The Null Crown) — the game is won
videos.synopsis: Gyroid rebuilds the Crown's tower stage by stage, installing the k-invariants Null threw away, and disconnects its collapse drive. The ringed island returns — hole and all — and every province is restored without erasing a single hole. Callback to the opening: shape changed, topology didn't. Decide Null's fate and Emmy's last line; credits carry Hatcher's Algebraic Topology attribution.
